title: Finite open presentation compatible with adjacent coefficient restriction
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E/Q_l, an open immersion j:X→Z and section-normalized operations o [lem-sf-integral-open-reduction-comparison]. Let e be any ordinary open coefficient comparison whose extension summands preserve sections [lem-sf-compact-support-proper-image-tower]. There exists a family of natural isomorphisms ι_n from the ordinary slice finite extension to intrinsic extension by zero [def-weil-extension-by-zero]. They commute with e.ordinary and the specified sfOpenRestriction coefficient square [lem-sf-compact-support-restriction-of-scalars], after the canonical equality of normalizedDVRModuleRes at n≤n+1 with sfCompactSupportFiniteRestriction. The commuting equation is SfFiniteOpenPresentationCompatible. This is an underived statement on all module sheaves, with no completed complex, proper map or tower isomorphism.

proof.text: For each coefficient use the section-normalized right restriction comparison. Compose the slice adjunction with the finite transport adjunction, transport its right adjoint along the chosen comparison, and apply left-adjoint uniqueness. This explicitly constructs the family of left comparisons.

Prove finiteExtension_hom_ext: the module sheafification adjunction reduces equality of maps from finite extension to equality from the direct-sum presheaf. The equality of the concrete forward transport gives an isomorphism on every section; its inverse shows that the finiteExtensionSection generators cover all direct-sum summands. DirectSum.induction_on completes presheaf equality.

Evaluate the desired adjacent square on a generator. sfFiniteOpenCoefficient_generator computes its intrinsic side. The equation e.sections identifies the ordinary side with the lower generator; scalar restriction does not change the underlying section map. Apply finiteExtension_hom_ext at each module, then natural-transformation and isomorphism extensionality. This is a full Lean assembly from the two finer obligations.

theorem sfFiniteOpenPresentation
    (e : CompactSupportProperImageTower.OpenData l E j o) :
    ∃ ι : ∀ n : ℕ, IntegralOpenReduction.finiteExtension l E j o n ≅
        sfIntrinsicExtensionByZero j (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1)),
      SfFiniteOpenPresentationCompatible l E j o e ι
